title: Maxime Rochkoulets
text:
I’m Maxime, an AI researcher working in Singapore (Genome Institute of Singapore).
Before that, I obtained a masters in computer science from KU Leuven.
My interests in ML lie mainly in non-supervised approaches (self-supervised / reinforcement learning).
Currently, I primarily work on foundation models for genomics.
I am open to PhD opportunities (starting in September 2027) so please do not hesitate to contact me.
